channel.title: Vidlark blog
channel.description: Guides, tutorials and comparisons for recording YouTube videos with your camera, mic and screen on a Mac or Windows PC, with Vidlark, the free recorder.

item.title: Use Your iPhone as a Webcam for YouTube Videos
item.description: Two ways to film YouTube videos with your iPhone as your Mac's camera: Continuity Camera, or Wi-Fi and a QR code with any Apple Account. Setup and framing tips.

item.title: Record a Video Podcast in One Room With Phones
item.description: Film a two or three person video podcast with phones as cameras and a mic for each person, all on one Mac, every angle synced by sound. Setup to final edit.

item.title: Open Source Loom Alternatives, Compared Honestly
item.description: Cap, Screenity, OBS Studio and Vidlark compared: licences in plain words, share links, self-hosting, project health on GitHub, and which one fits your videos.

item.title: Loom Free Plan Limits in 2026, Checked
item.description: Loom's free Starter plan, checked on 9 October 2026: the 5 minute cap, the 25 video limit, 720p, no downloads, what Business costs, and free ways around each.

item.title: How to Record a YouTube Video on a Mac
item.description: The whole path from script to upload on a Mac, with free tools: plan, light, record your face and screen, fix mistakes, add chapters and publish to YouTube.

item.title: How to Record Yourself and Your Screen on a Mac
item.description: Three free ways to get your face and your screen in one video on a Mac: QuickTime's floating camera, the Screenshot toolbar, or one button in Vidlark.

item.title: How to Record Online Course Videos at Home
item.description: A repeatable home setup for recording course lessons in batches: plan short lessons, script each one, record a day's list, and upload in your platform's format.

item.title: Free Mac Screen Recorders With No Watermark
item.description: The free Mac screen recorders with no watermark and no time limit, which ones also record your camera and the Mac's sound, and which Macs each one runs on.

item.title: Free Loom Alternatives With No Limit, No Catch
item.description: Free recorders with no time limit, no watermark and no account, and the one honest trade-off: no instant share link. Which fits your videos, and when Loom wins.
